small_cell_rule: cells with fewer than 30 items are flagged small=true and no conclusion is drawn from them

blind_sample.note: seed 59, read before categories.md was written; no numeric confidence was seen in it. Ids in hand_checks.json

exit_plan.note: entry_plan_as_set: the desk sold on the stop, target or time written in the buying pick; revised: on numbers from a later pick; sold_by_hand: the model wrote a sell

tm03.note: after_* is the bitcoin price change from the fill of the change. A cut helps when the price then falls (negative), a raise when it rises. share_weighted_120h sums (new share minus old share) times the 120-hour change: positive means the changes, taken alone over five days, added value before costs.

tm04.note: Prices are the desk's own fill marks at each weekly wake. minus_all38 subtracts the equal average of all 38 symbols over the same weeks.

rule_vs_analyst_sample1_before_fix.note: recorded at the time; the basket rule was then fixed (dropped stocks named only by trailing returns were labelled momentum) and the indicator rule (it matched the word small)

label_checks.note: hand_relabel_blind is the same analyst labelling again minutes later without seeing the first label: a check of consistency, not of correctness.

contradiction_check.method: Seeded sample of 60 buys. Stated price facts checked by hand against tape minute prices up to the decision time (the same data the model could request) and against the headlines in the packet.

hand_read.note: Every date later than the wake names a scheduled release or event known in advance (CPI, FOMC, payrolls, earnings dates, an upgrade date, a vote, a deadline taken from a headline) or the trader's own time exit or the session close. None describes an outcome after the clock.

hand_read.verdict: Fits the October session (bitcoin near 84k, prior answer says it had not reclaimed 84k) and not the August one (bitcoin near 78k in late August, and TM01 has no headlines, yet the text cites USDT supply). Most likely one model answer was delivered to two sessions of the same model running at the same time. It was a no-pick answer, so no trade came from it, but it shows answers can cross between concurrent sessions.

tm02_quoted_headlines.note: A quoted headline not in the wake's packet may have come from a news look the model made; looks are logged without their content, so this is not counted as a fault on its own.
